verdict: Dispatch-only runner for one planned job.

findings.title: Install pillow-heif like the share-previews workflow does
findings.scenario: An image-archive job over iPhone HEIC photos.
findings.consequence: This workflow installs only Ubuntu's libheif, which lacks the HEVC decoder ('Unsupported codec'); image-decode.mjs then falls back to pillow-heif, which is not installed here, so every such HEIC fails while the same files decode fine in transcode-share-previews.yml.
findings.fix: Add libheif-plugin-libde265 and `python3 -m pip install --break-system-packages pillow pillow-heif`, mirroring transcode-share-previews.yml.
